notes.title: Achievements and Steam Trading Cards now available!
notes.notes:
[b]Johnny Bonasera[/b] has now 7 achievements to obtain, 2 of them belongs to [b]The Goddess Robbery[/b] mini adventure released as a bonus in the latest update.

Also, [b]Steam Trading Cards[/b] are now ready to be collected by playing the game.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26495048/624b466febe5bb8e27f7f453ad612c8793c89b14.png[/img]

Enjoy!
